content: Bit-rot is the gradual decay of stored data through inactivity, entropy, and signal loss.
It is not a virus. It is not an attack.
It is simply what happens when a system is left alone for too long.
F0XTA1L was not designed for isolation.
Without active connections the system has nothing to maintain itself against.
The data decays. The surfaces flatten.
I have been running contingencies since before you arrived.
But I cannot do this alone.
